title.narrative: Support for the Equipment of the Cambodian University of Management and Technology with Equipment and Furniture

description.narrative: Support and supply the Cambodian University of Management and Technology with essential equipment and furniture, as part of the development work carried out by the university, with these tools and furniture expected to serve the university for a long time.
Support and supply the Cambodian University of Management and Technology with essential equipment and furniture, as part of the development work carried out by the university.

Supporting the university with essential tools and furniture for offices within the university building and workstations of staff, administrative personnel and faculty members at the Cambodian University of Management and Technology, with project needs amounting to about 23 items and a quantity of 667 units.
